label: Give every existing event a delivery for SEARCH

precheck.description: the event state is still on the event
precheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'OutboxEvent' AND column_name = 'status')

execute.description: copy each event state into a delivery
execute.sql:
INSERT INTO "public"."OutboxDelivery"
  ("id", "eventId", "consumer", "status", "attemptCount", "nextAttemptAt", "lastError", "processedAt", "createdAt")
SELECT uuidv7()::text, event."id", 'SEARCH'::"OutboxConsumer",
  CASE WHEN event."status" = 'FAILED'::"OutboxStatus" THEN 'FAILED'::"OutboxStatus" ELSE 'PENDING'::"OutboxStatus" END,
  CASE WHEN event."status" = 'FAILED'::"OutboxStatus" THEN event."attemptCount" ELSE 0 END,
  now(),
  CASE WHEN event."status" = 'FAILED'::"OutboxStatus" THEN event."lastError" END,
  NULL,
  event."createdAt"
FROM "public"."OutboxEvent" AS event
ON CONFLICT ("eventId", "consumer") DO NOTHING

postcheck.description: every event has a delivery for it
postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "public"."OutboxEvent" AS event
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "public"."OutboxDelivery" AS delivery
    WHERE delivery."eventId" = event."id" AND delivery."consumer" = 'SEARCH'::"OutboxConsumer"
  )
)
